partner_result_applied.application: For Q0=2XY+Z^2+2ZU with pivots (X,Z), leaves (Y,U), C=diag(0,1), M=I2, the completed grouped determinant receiver gives P(Q0 in I)<=2|I| and essential density height <=2.

new_results.statement: A measurable mixture of conditional C0 densities dominated in L-infinity by an integrable H is C0 and has height at most EH; continuity is a no-loss upgrade after height is paid.
If after original-coordinate conditioning Q=R(P)+dU^2+a(P)U+(2m.P+beta)V with d!=0, m!=0, no UV and no V^2 term, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=6|d|^(-1/3)max_j|m_j|^(-2/3) and p_Q is in C0.

For Q=-X^2-Z^2+Y^2+2XY+2ZU, eigenvalues are +-sqrt(2),(-1+-sqrt(5))/2; three magnitudes are >=1 and the new receiver gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=6 with p_Q in C0. Only one physical diagonal is zero, so no two-leaf zero internal block exists in this 4x4 matrix.

unresolved_implication: Handle a genuinely nonzero 2x2 leaf quadratic block, especially indefinite, by averaging its logarithmic critical singularity against the pivot-generated affine coefficient before fiber supremum, or structurally route remaining matrices to paid original-product receivers.
next_step: Attempt the rank-two indefinite leaf block using the pair-log envelope and a distributional estimate for the moving critical value that retains original product provenance.
